rationale: Latest 1m candle closed on its exact low after the prior bar closed on its high, breaking the tight consolidation pattern of repeated highs that existed at entry. Price remains above the 5m 9-EMA and within the positive SPY/VIXY regime, yet elevated 7x relative volume and position still at only 19.3% of the day's range after a 7.6% gap show sellers have not yet exhausted. Mechanical evidence for continued long recovery to VWAP has therefore weakened enough to exit the small 0.12% gain rather than hold or reverse.
